premises.text: Traditional enterprise database servers struggle with processing large datasets efficiently.
premises.evidence_span: it was taking our enterprise database server 35 hours to run

premises.text: Distributing processing on GPUs can significantly reduce query execution time.
premises.evidence_span: that 35-hour monstrosity came down to 30 seconds

premises.text: BlazingDB is a next-generation SQL database optimized for GPU processing.
premises.evidence_span: BlazingDB unlocks that power for enterprises who need massive scale and hyper-fast SQL

premises.text: BlazingDB can handle large datasets quickly, providing results in milliseconds.
premises.evidence_span: we're able to get that back in less than a second

premises.text: BlazingDB's performance is superior to traditional databases like Redshift, Postgres, and MySQL.
premises.evidence_span: we were running five times faster across our different queries

premises.text: BlazingDB is designed to be fully distributed and self-configuring based on hardware and usage.
premises.evidence_span: It is a fully distributed technology that splits the data and the computation across multiple servers

premises.text: SQL databases are more widely used and have a larger market than NoSQL databases.
premises.evidence_span: businesses spent around $1.2 billion on NoSQL databases. But $38 billion on SQL databases

premises.text: BlazingDB is being adopted by large companies with significant data processing needs.
premises.evidence_span: large companies with huge data problems are reaching out to us

premises.text: BlazingDB can operate in various environments, not just the cloud.
premises.evidence_span: BlazingDB was built for the cloud. But it actually works anywhere that has the appropriate specs

value.text: Enterprises can process large datasets quickly and efficiently using BlazingDB.
value.evidence_span: process millions of rows a second on your laptop
